problems.explain: The common denominator is (x + 1)(x + 4). Multiply each fraction up to it: (x + 4) over it, plus (x + 1) over it. Combine the numerators: (x + 4) + (x + 1) = 2x + 5. So (2x + 5)/((x + 1)(x + 4)), which is the same as (2x + 5)/(x² + 5x + 4) with the bottom multiplied out.
